newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Rosenbauer plans unchanged 15 ATS dividend.
newsitem.headline: Rosenbauer plans unchanged 15 ATS dividend.

text.p: Rosenbauer International AG, Austria's leading manufacturer of fire engines, said on Wednesday it expects to pay an unchanged dividend of 15 schillings in 1996.

Earlier, Rosenbauer reported a first half group net loss of eight million schillings compared with break-even the previous year. It traced the loss to an increased tax burden due to government budget cuts.
Finance director Robert Kastil said the tax burden of around 20 million schillings in the first half was a one-off and would not have an impact on the dividend.
Rosenbauer expects to make up lost ground in the second half and end the year with a set of positive earnings.
The company forecasts group sales of two billion schillings after 1.94 billion in 1995, and sees group pre-tax surpassing the 65.5 million schillings posted last year.
Rosenbauer also expects net profit to be in the double-digit black. In 1995, the group reported a net profit of 46.5 million schillings. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 274
